description: This file defines internal static class 'MessagingInstruments' responsible for collecting and reporting various messaging-related metrics, such as bytes sent/received, message counts, ping statistics, and message sizes within the Orleans runtime infrastructure.

classes.name: MessagingInstruments
classes.description: Internal static class for messaging metrics instrumentation within Orleans runtime.

methods.name: OnMessageExpired
methods.description: Records an expired message event with the specified phase.

methods.name: OnPingSend
methods.description: Records a ping send event to a destination silo address.

methods.name: OnPingReceive
methods.description: Records a ping receive event from a destination silo address.

methods.name: OnPingReplyReceived
methods.description: Records a ping reply received event from a replier silo address.

methods.name: OnPingReplyMissed
methods.description: Records a missed ping reply event from a replier silo address.

methods.name: OnFailedSentMessage
methods.description: Increments counter for a failed sent message, if message has a direction.

methods.name: OnDroppedSentMessage
methods.description: Increments counter for a dropped sent message, if message has a direction.

methods.name: OnRejectedMessage
methods.description: Increments counter for a rejected message, if message has a direction.

methods.name: OnMessageReceive
methods.description: Records message reception, updates histogram and header byte count.

methods.name: OnMessageSend
methods.description: Records message sending, updates histogram and header byte count.
